claim: In the matching retail DLL, Menu_SoundManager.Play_MatchSE (0x060052A8) is a static two-parameter method named snd_no and volume with an exact 122-byte body. It returns if Sound_ClipMatchSE_List is null, if snd_no is outside raw range 0..108, or if Sound_ClipMatchSE_List[snd_no] compares equal to null. It computes local volume = Volume_Se * volume, returns when the emitted bge.un against 0.0f does not continue, caps local volume to 1.0f when the emitted ble.un against 1.0f does not continue, selects audioSrcInfo[2], calls AudioSrcInfo.sRefAudio.set_volume(local volume), then calls AudioSrcInfo.sRefAudio.PlayOneShot(Sound_ClipMatchSE_List[snd_no]) and returns. FACT-0060 pins the canonical caller at MatchSEPlayer.PlayMatchSE IL+0x0170 with current seid and vol.
